description: Show or hide mold-draft violations on the active part, in the part local frame. on true flags side walls below 1° of draft relative to the mold-analysis pull and lists ejector-pin and sleeve candidate counts. Those candidates are a heuristic. on false removes the skin so face paint and the part colour show again. Omit on to toggle. Read-only. Not CAD draft mode, not an automatic draft fix, and not a quote.

on.description: true shows mold-draft violations and ejector counts. false restores paint and the part colour. Omit to toggle.

name: mold_draft
